title: Geodetic Moments
statement: Look to the horizon and measure where you stand.
notes: Lazy minted on the OpenSea shared storefront. The ones never sold have no chain record at all, so they are read from OpenSea and are tokenized on purchase like the recent paintings.

works.title: Geodetic Moment #1
works.statement: Look to the horizon and measure where you stand. Geodetic Moments explores how small shifts in our position can dramatically change what we see. Look forward and see what’s possible.
